quarterly_data.quarter: L3Harris press release: L3Harris Receives THAAD Propulsion Contract Valued at $6 (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: L3Harris received an undefinitized contract from Lockheed Martin valued at more than $6 billion (excluding escalations) over seven years to significantly expand propulsion production for the THAAD system, following the framework agreement with the Department of War to quadruple THAAD propulsion production; the company says this award and the PAC-3 MSE propulsion contract are consistent with its previously announced expectations for both programs. It will construct a new facility for THAAD Solid Rocket Boost Motor manufacturing and is expanding capacity for THAAD Liquid Divert and Attitude Control production.
quarterly_data.figure: more than $6 billion over seven years (excluding escalations)
